skills_match.name: Skills match
skills_match.question: How well do the candidate's technical skills cover the technical skills the job requires?
criteria: Almost none of the required skills

experience_level_match.name: Experience level match
experience_level_match.question: How well do the candidate's years of relevant experience match what the job asks for?

domain_industry_relevance.name: Domain/industry relevance
domain_industry_relevance.question: How relevant is the candidate's industry or domain background to the job's industry?

education_qualifications_match.name: Education/qualifications match
education_qualifications_match.question: How well do the candidate's degrees and qualifications meet the job's requirements?

seniority_role_level_fit.name: Seniority/role-level fit
seniority_role_level_fit.question: How well does the candidate's current seniority and role type fit the level of this job?

career_trajectory_fit.name: Career trajectory fit
career_trajectory_fit.question: How natural a next step would this job be, given the candidate's career so far?

responsibilities_overlap.name: Responsibilities overlap
responsibilities_overlap.question: How much do the candidate's past duties overlap with the job's responsibilities?

location_work_arrangement_fit.name: Location/work-arrangement fit
location_work_arrangement_fit.question: How compatible are the candidate's location and work arrangement with the job's (remote, hybrid, onsite, region)?

soft_skills_match.name: Soft-skills match
soft_skills_match.question: How well does the CV show the soft skills the job asks for?

recency_of_relevant_experience.name: Recency of relevant experience
recency_of_relevant_experience.question: How recent is the candidate's experience that is relevant to this job?

cv_clarity_structure_quality.name: CV clarity/structure quality
cv_clarity_structure_quality.question: How clear and well-structured is the CV text?

job_post_clarity_structure_quality.name: Job post clarity/structure quality
job_post_clarity_structure_quality.question: How clear and well-structured is the job description text?

overall_fit_score.name: Overall Fit Score
overall_fit_score.question: Overall, how well does the candidate fit this job?

cv_likely_llm_generated.name: CV likely LLM-generated
cv_likely_llm_generated.question: How likely is it that the CV text was generated by an LLM?

job_post_likely_llm_generated.name: Job post likely LLM-generated
job_post_likely_llm_generated.question: How likely is it that the job description text was generated by an LLM?

interview_readiness_score.name: Interview-Readiness Score
interview_readiness_score.question: How likely is a recruiter to invite this candidate to interview for this job?

culture_company_alignment_score.name: Culture/company-alignment score
culture_company_alignment_score.question: How well does the candidate align with the company's mission, culture and values as described in the job description?
